point_one_role_text: Clarify how Hanshin turned an early advantage into a decisive win: Sato Teruaki’s first-inning two-run homer created the lead, but the seventh- and eighth-inning runs completed the separation after Hiroshima’s lone score.
point_two_role_text: Interpret Ihara’s start as damage control rather than a shutout performance: he allowed only two hits and one run, and Hiroshima’s entire scoring came from Montero’s solo homer.
